Ammanford Association Football Club is a football club from Ammanford, Carmarthenshire in Wales. They play in the Cymru Premier. They are now based at the Recreation Ground in Ammanford. The club is affiliated to the Football Association of Wales (FAW) and the West Wales Football Association (WWFA).
